title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
statement: Quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 exists for every compact simple gauge group and has a mass gap.
how_it_was_proved: Not proved. Bhattacharjee and Bhattacharya proved the lattice mass gap of four-dimensional SU(2) for Wilson coupling beta_W < 2/9, the limit of single-link Dobrushin arguments, with m >= -log(9 beta_W / 2), and proved that lattice inequalities uniform in the spacing cannot by themselves give the continuum gap.

sources.cite: D. Bhattacharjee and U. Bhattacharya, Mass gap of lattice Yang-Mills theory up to the Dobrushin ceiling, Zenodo (2026)
T. Balaban, Renormalization group approach to lattice gauge field theories I, Commun. Math. Phys. 109 (1987) 249-301
K. Osterwalder and E. Seiler, Gauge field theories on a lattice, Ann. Phys. 110 (1978) 440-471

steps.statement: No spacing-uniform lattice inequality gives the continuum gap
Control of the renormalization steps at order-one coupling, uniformly in the spacing
A continuum limit with a positive gap

ladder.statement: small-field renormalization steps at weak coupling, uniformly in the spacing
cluster expansion and a gap at strong coupling
the same at beta_W < 2/9 by single-link Dobrushin estimates
renormalization steps at order-one coupling joining the two regimes
